evidence: PDF p.72 (p072.png) v.409b prints «ءَاتَىٰنِـــــــ» with a long horizontal tail after the kasra-marked nūn (no final yāʾ); pack/A/c05.md line 196 reproduces this as 7 tatweels («ءَاتَىٰنِـــــــ»).
reasoning: The 7-tatweel run leaves «نِ» in dangling medial form before a space, matching the known multi-tatweel anomaly in weak-spots/c05.md (likely a PDF typesetting artifact where a final yāʾ was removed leaving its kashida, since the Tawil meter requires short «نِ ءَا يَا» = فَعُولُنْ). Stripping the trailing tatweels to «ءَاتَىٰنِ» removes the stray glyphs without changing reading or meter.
